content: Root cause: The bug was caused by the incorrect usage of try-with-resources for the ResultSet in the `SimpleJDBCRecordStore` class, which needed to stay open for further processing. This resulted in the premature closing of the ResultSet, leading to potential issues when accessing the data after the execution of the SQL query. The patch corrected this by removing the try-with-resources construct for the ResultSet while ensuring proper resource management in other areas.
